findings.where: "Where we're starting" section heading, against the hero's h1 wordmark (desktop, and on phone too)
findings.fault: The section heading is set about twice as large as the hero's "MantaHostels" h1. When you squint, a plain section label is the loudest thing on the page, louder than the brand and the hero claim. The hierarchy across sections is upside down.
findings.who_objects: A first-time visitor scanning the page. Their eye goes to "Where we're starting" before the name and the promise, so the page seems to open on a sub-section rather than on what MantaHostels is.

findings.where: Desktop first screen: the destinations section below the wave
findings.fault: The heading's two oversized lines take up the whole bottom third of the first screen. All three destination cards get pushed below the fold. The first view ends in a wall of heading with nothing to act on, so the page's second job, sending people to the destination guides, can't be seen without scrolling.
findings.who_objects: A backpacker who came to look at Bali or Lombok hostels. The first screen shows no destinations, only a heading saying they exist.

findings.where: Hero text column against the nav wordmark, the destinations heading and the cards (desktop)
findings.fault: The hero copy and buttons start about 230 px to the right of the left edge that the nav wordmark, the section heading and the card row all share. The page has two unrelated left edges, so the eye can't follow one line down it (a continuity break).
findings.who_objects: Any desktop visitor. The jog makes the hero look like it belongs to another page that was dropped into this one.

findings.where: Hero action pair: the coral "Email luc@…" button and the "Explore destinations" outline button (desktop and phone)
findings.fault: The two actions are stacked, with different widths and different shapes: a fully rounded pill above a square-cornered box. They don't read as one set of choices (a similarity break). On phone the coral label wraps onto two lines, so it turns into a tall slab beside the one-line outline button.
findings.who_objects: A visitor choosing between the two actions. The mismatched pair looks unfinished, and on phone the two-line coral block reads as clumsy rather than confident.

findings.where: Ink wave band under the hero, and the manta illustration in it (desktop)
findings.fault: The wave band is a strip of about 130 px of empty ink between the hero and the next section. The manta sits at the far right edge, outside the content column that every other element lines up to. The band adds height without grouping or framing anything, and the mascot floats loose from the layout.
findings.who_objects: A desktop visitor scrolling down. There's a dead pause before the content, and the mascot looks stuck in a corner rather than placed.
